format_contract.e2m1: sign bit 3, two exponent bits, one mantissa bit
format_contract.gguf: one E8M0 scale byte followed by 16 bytes pairing values j and j+16 low/high
format_contract.source: 16 bytes encode adjacent value pairs low/high plus one E8M0 scale per 32 values

independence.gguf_reader_role: metadata and raw tensor byte access only
independence.implementation: project-side explicit E2M1/E8M0 and nibble decoder

sampling.position_definition: first, floor(total_blocks/2), and last block in row-major tensor order
